description: Reference code: JR129259 Who are we? A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. Qu’attendons-nous de vous ? Vous possédez une expérience confirmée sur un poste similaire et/ou en cabinet de conseil en stratégie et/ou organisation ainsi qu’une expérience dans l’univers retail. Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités d’analyse, de structuration et d’animation. Vous êtes familier avec l’exposition aux comités de direction et avez une maitrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais. Correspondez-vous au profil ? Rattaché(e) à la directrice Organisation & Planification Stratégique, vous opérez comme un véritable cabinet de conseil interne à la Maison, intervenant sur des problématiques transverses et structurantes liées au développement organisationnel de la Maison. Vous êtes mandatées par des membres du comité exécutif. Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous : Accompagnez les équipes dans la formalisation d’une vision stratégique prospective, ainsi que dans l’identification des enjeux opérationnels et organisationnels. Pilotez les projets : en définissant les objectifs, le cadrage et l’approche projet. Participez au processus budgétaire en collaboration avec les ressources humaines. Apportez un support méthodologique afin de porter la culture projet en interne. Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière ! Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c'est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition. Dès votre intégration, vous serez immergé dans l’univers de la Maison grâce à des formations sur notre histoire, notre savoir-faire et notre culture. Le processus de recrutement Postulez directement en ligne. Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l'équipe RH pour un entretien. Vous rencontrez la Directrice Projet Organisation. Sinon, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature. Una casa di alto angelo con un forte Jempel con un forte Jempel con un forte Jempel e un grande aiuto in un ambiente commerciale e creativo. La nostra Maison è alla ricerca di persone e contribuire a sviluppare e Aspettarsi la loro esperienza con cura e nessun compromesso. A Van Cleef & Arpels sarete ricchi di esperti e contribuirà a molti nuovi progetti in Come la nostra Maison di essere membro del Consiglio Nazionale d'Europa. Crediamo che la diversità e l'inclusione della comunità siano le stesse della diversità e dell'inclusione della comunità, e della creatività e della conoscenza della seriologia. Cosa ci aspettiamo da voi? Avete una comprovata esperienza in una posizione simile e/o in una società di consulenza in strategia e/o organizzazione e un'esperienza nel mondo, archico. Avete eccellenti competenze in analisi, strutturazione e d, animazione. Conoscete l'esposizione ai comitati esecutivi e avete una perfetta padronanza del francese e dell'inglese. descriptionByLocale.en: Reference code: JR129259 Who are we? A High Jewelry House with a strong heritage who promote exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment. Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself. At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to attract talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that when diversity and inclusion are fully embraced and empowered, creativity and knowledge emerge to deliver excellence. What do we expect from you? You have confirmed experience in a similar position and/or consulting firm in strategy and/or organization as well as experience in the retail universe. You have excellent analytical, structuring and animation capabilities. You are familiar with the exposure to the executive committees and have a perfect mastery of French and English. Do you fit the profile? Attached to the Director Organization & Strategic Planning, you operate as a real internal consulting firm at La Maison, working on cross-cutting and structuring issues related to the organizational development of the House. You are mandated by members of the Executive Committee. As part of your missions, you: Support teams in formalizing a forward-looking strategic vision, as well as identifying operational and organizational issues. Lead projects: by defining objectives, framing and project approach. Participate in the budget process in collaboration with human resources. Provide methodological support to bring the project culture internally. More than a job... We're recruiting for a career! Integrating Van Cleef & Arpels is above all a team where the development of employees is at the heart of our ambition. From your integration, you will be immersed in the world of the House thanks to trainings on our history, know-how and culture. The recruitment process Apply directly online. If your profile is selected, you are contacted by the HR team for an interview. You meet the Director Project Organization. Otherwise, you will receive an email informing you of the refusal of your application.
